import polars as pl

def dataframes_equal(df1: pl.DataFrame, df2: pl.DataFrame) -> bool:
    """
    Returns True when two polars DataFrames are exactly equal (same schema and same values).
    
    Args:
        df1: First polars DataFrame
        df2: Second polars DataFrame
    
    Returns:
        bool: True if schemas and values are identical, False otherwise
    """
    return df1.equals(df2)


# Test cases
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Identical DataFrames
    df1 = pl.DataFrame({
        "a": [1, 2, 3],
        "b": ["x", "y", "z"],
        "c": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
    })
    df2 = pl.DataFrame({
        "a": [1, 2, 3],
        "b": ["x", "y", "z"],
        "c": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
    })
    
    # Different values
    df3 = pl.DataFrame({
        "a": [1, 2, 4],
        "b": ["x", "y", "z"],
        "c": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
    })
    
    # Different schema (column name)
    df4 = pl.DataFrame({
        "a": [1, 2, 3],
        "b": ["x", "y", "z"],
        "d": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
    })
    
    # Different schema (data type)
    df5 = pl.DataFrame({
        "a": [1, 2, 3],
        "b": ["x", "y", "z"],
        "c": [1, 2, 3]
    })
    
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df2))  # True
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df3))  # False (different values)
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df4))  # False (different column name)
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df5))  # False (different data type)
